Baseten powers mission-critical inference for dynamic AI companies by combining applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and developer tooling to bring cutting-edge models into production. The Software Engineer on the Dedicated Inference team will build developer experiences for deploying and operating AI workloads, including CLI and SDK tools, APIs, observability, and debugging workflows. The role involves developing products, designing APIs, resolving customer issues, and working across React and Kubernetes-based systems.
